ingredientSections.heading: Roast Lamb
items: 4 pcs. Lamb shoulder approx. 500-700g in total

methodSections.heading: Roast Lamb
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Cut the lamb into 4 equal pieces and place into a deep baking pan or dish. Break apart and peel the garlic and place the whole cloves into the pan. Chop the onion and add to the lamb with the oregano, salt, pepper and bay leaves. Add the mustard and lemon juice.

Pour stock over all the ingredients until it covers the lamb. Depending on the size of your baking pan, you may need to top up with more stock or water. Cover with tin foil or a lid ensuring a tight seal.
Roast at 190°C (375°F) for 4 hours. After 3 hours check the liquid level; you may wish to top it up. The lamb will be ready when the bones are easy to remove.

methodSections.heading: Greek Salad
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the cucumber and red onion. Cube the feta and toss all ingredients together in a big bowl. Dress with olive oil and cracked green peppercorns.
